system.description: When you choose this tradition at 2nd Level, you gain the ability to learn ninjutsu with the Fire Release Keyword. If you already have access to this nature release, you learn 2 Fire Release Ninjutsu that you qualify for, one of which can be C-Rank or lower. You can also learn and create Ninjutsu with the Fire Release Keyword in half the required time.

rules.text: When you choose this tradition: if you already had the affinity, 2 Bonus Jutsu slots for Fire Release Ninjutsu (one may be up to C-Rank above your highest rank; automatic); learn and create them in half the time.
